lines.text: The disciples ask who is greatest, and Jesus has a little child stand among them and says the humble one is greatest.
Jesus says anyone who causes a little one to stumble would be better off with a millstone around his neck.
A man with a hundred sheep leaves the ninety-nine on the hills to search for the one that is lost.
If a brother sins, confront him privately, then take one or two others, then tell it to the priests.
Jesus says if two agree on earth, it will be done by the angels in heaven.
